answer_2.quote: Beyond the conventional Micro F1 score, we recognize the significance of the Out-of-Vocabulary (OOV) error as a crucial metric for assessing a word segmentation model's generalization capacity. Consequently, we introduce OOV recall (R_oov) to evaluate the generalization ability of SLGAN in the WS task. Furthermore, to ascertain the model's reliability and consistency, we monitor the Standard Deviation (SD) values across multiple experiments.
